facts.fact: 为听麦金莱总统演讲，众人提前吃晚饭，Clara 与 Ben、Mrs. Guthrie、Mr. Allen 乘马车前往 Pioneer Hall 参加南北战争老兵招待会。
facts.anchor: We have dinner early that night so we can attend a Civil War Veterans reception at Pioneer Hall and hear President McKinley speak.
facts.relation: Clara（叙述者）与 Ben 同乘一辆马车；Mrs. Guthrie 为东道主（当晚众人回到 Mrs. Guthrie 家）；Mr. Allen（William）同行赴会

facts.fact: Clara 注意到麦金莱总统身旁一名男子低头看腕表，随即低声问 Ben：腕表是何时发明的。（本章转折点）
facts.anchor: That man next to the president is wearing a wristwatch.
facts.relation: Clara 对 Ben（同伴、同为穿越者）低声求证

facts.fact: Ben 回答 Clara 的提问：腕表约出现于十九世纪中叶，但直到第一次世界大战后才流行、开始量产。
facts.anchor: But I don’t think they were popular until after World War I. At least, that’s when they began to be mass-produced.
facts.relation: Ben 与 Clara 同为被困过去的穿越者，互相核对史实
facts.number: mid-nineteenth century; after World War I

facts.fact: Ben 向 Mrs. Guthrie 借观剧望远镜观察该男子，随后向 Clara 耳语确认：那块表太现代，他敢以全部身家打赌此人来自未来。
facts.anchor: “The watch is too modern,” he whispers to me. “And from studying him, I’d bet my fortune he’s from the future.”
facts.relation: Ben 对 Clara 耳语确认；望远镜借自 Mrs. Guthrie

facts.fact: Clara 认出该男子是穿越前一天在公寓走廊里见过的人并告知 Ben；Ben 随即推断此人知道镜子的原理、能告诉他们如何回家。
facts.anchor: He was at my apartment. The day before I fell through. The one I told you about seeing in the hallway when me and my friend came back from dinner.
facts.relation: 该男子＝Clara 穿越前在公寓走廊见过之人（Clara 曾与朋友一起撞见他）；Ben 与 Clara 是同伴
facts.number: The day before I fell through（穿越前一天）

facts.fact: 该男子与 Clara 对视后，朝麦金莱总统耳语一句便混入人群消失；Clara 和 Ben 追到大厅出口，门外街道太挤，那人不见了。
facts.anchor: A second later he whispers something in President McKinley’s ear and melts into the crowd.
facts.relation: 该男子随行在麦金莱总统身边；他已认出 Clara（对视时瞪视、咬紧下颚）

facts.fact: Ben 分析该未来人接近麦金莱的动机可能与九月遇刺有关（并提到西奥多·罗斯福将继任），计划明早设法进入麦金莱在旧金山下榻的宅邸打听此人身份。
facts.anchor: McKinley will be assassinated in September—that’s the only reason I can think that someone else from the future would try to gain access to him.
facts.relation: Ben 对 Clara 的推断；麦金莱为时任美国总统

facts.fact: Ben 送 Clara 回房、替她解开裙后的小珍珠扣，随后吻了她；Clara 心想若被人撞见就必须嫁给 Ben——至少为了表面体面。（结尾钩子）
facts.anchor: If anyone catches us doing this, I will definitely have to marry Ben. At least for appearances.
facts.relation: Ben 与 Clara 罗曼关系升温（Ben 事后自言 We really just met）
